anti_homogenization_rule: No requirement that transitions exhibit the same frontier shape. Degenerate all-retired, partial, or all-compatible frontiers are accepted if source semantics imply them.
next_gate: Public independent static/semantic qualification of source identities, state-space derivations, expected frontier tables, and label firewall. No scientific cell may open until PASS is sealed.
scientific_question: Across every semantic transition admitted by the frozen exhaustive upstream census, does ReplayMark recover the prospectively frozen historical-action compatibility frontier without unsafe reuse or unnecessary native recovery?

state_space_law.compression: Any runtime compression must be an exact causal-path-preserving quotient of a prospectively enumerated finite semantic superspace.
state_space_law.historical_frontier_domain: shared old/new valid configuration domain only
state_space_law.new_only_features: allowed only as non-promotional extension witnesses

transition_specific_shapes.T01: binary schedule-state domain; full retirement is permitted and expected if the old operation family has no identical New Direct action
transition_specific_shapes.T02: 144-state reachable finite superspace compressed to all 42 causal-path-preserving classes

uniform_claim_boundary.reason: Preserves the same native consequential-action boundary used by the prior VE1 Home Assistant experiment and avoids post hoc effect-level equivalence.
